desc: Finalize solution approach: use a trie with node counts, precompute Euler tour intervals, and for each index compute max(on_path_max, off_path_max) with off_path_max obtained by scanning a depth-sorted list of candidate nodes (count >= k) and skipping ancestors.
Implement the trie node class and insert all words while tracking per-word terminal nodes and node counts (including root).
Perform DFS to assign tin/tout to all nodes for ancestor checks.
Build and sort the list of candidate nodes (count >= k) by depth descending.
For each index i, compute on_path_max by walking the word's path and checking count >= k+1.
For each index i, compute off_path_max by scanning candidates and returning the first depth whose node is not an ancestor of the terminal node (using tin/tout).
Final answer is max(on_path_max, off_path_max) for each i; return the list.
Test with provided examples and edge cases (e.g., k=1, n<k, duplicate words).
